title: Why Do Your Fingers Wrinkle in Water?
sources: Kareklas et al. 2013, Biology Letters: Water-induced finger wrinkles improve handling of wet objects
O'Riain 1973, New and simple test of nerve function in hand (sympathetic vasomotor wrinkling)

lines.text: Why do your fingers actually wrinkle in the bath?
Most people think skin absorbs water like a sponge. Total myth!
It's an involuntary reflex from your nervous system!
Your brain commands blood vessels in your fingertips to shrink,
creating tire treads to grip wet objects without slipping.
In fact, if your finger nerves are cut, they will never wrinkle!
